newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Kaikai issues 80 mln B shares on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Kaikai issues 80 mln B shares on Friday.

text.p: Garment maker Shanghai Kaikai Industrial Co Ltd on Friday offered 80 million B shares for sale at $0.256 per share, officials said.
The shares will be listed on the Shanghai stock exchange in mid-January.

An official with Shenyin & Wanguo, lead underwriter of the issue, said the shares had attracted big interest from investors, particularly in Hong Kong and Singapore, due to its strong earnings growth record.
He said the shares will be listed in the middle of January but the exact date has yet to be decided.
A company statement said on Friday that the issue will result in total proceeds of $19.15 million. Part of the proceeds will be used to open a department store and 20 outlets.

After the issue, Kaikai will have total share capital of 198 million shares, including 80 million B shares, 71.74 million state shares, 31.26 million shares held by domestic institutions and 15 million shares issued to staff, it said.

Kaikai, whose net assets are valued at 196.95 million yuan, forecast after-tax profits of 60.117 million yuan for 1996, compared with 60.02 million yuan last year and 36.38 million yuan in 1994, under international accounting standards, the statement said.
